Data Format Description: This data comes from the Dynamic Gravity Systems AT1M gravimeter on board the Thomas G. Thompson. The column names and units are sourced from the tgt_scs_sensorinfo_dec2025v2 Excel file.

Data line column descriptions (one description per unique line format):

    Example Line: 04/08/2024,21:13:49.124,$AT1M_3.61_11963397,-166461,91700,-162276,4076925,208,511,198,1376207,176472,396877,236223,266,6026584,0.0000000000,0.0000000000,0.0000,0.0000,00000416110957
    where:
          04/08/2024            Date
          21:13:49.124          Time (UTC)
          $AT1M_3.61_11963397   Meter_version
          -166461               Gravity (mGal)
          91700                 Long Accelerometer (Gals)
          -162276               Cross Accelerometer (Gals)
          4076925               Beam (Gals)
          208                   Temp (deg C)
          511                   Pressure (in Hg)
          198                   Electronic Temp (deg C)
          1376207               VCC (mGal)
          176472                VE (mGal)
          396877                AL (mGal)
          236223                AX (mGal)
          266                   Status
          6026584               Check Sum
          0.0000000000          Latitude (dec deg)
          0.0000000000          Longitude (dec deg)
          0.0000                Speed (knots)
          0.0000                Course (deg)
          00000416110957        Time (sec)
